speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The National Research Foundation (NRF) seeks to build strong research expertise and a dynamic Research, Innovation and Enterprise (RIE) ecosystem that advances Singapore’s competitiveness and drives societal and economic impact for Singapore and the world.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: This will be achieved through our RIE 2030 efforts.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Through steady investments in science and technology, NRF has built a strong research and talent base, alongside a promising innovation and enterprise system.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We are leveraging deep scientific capabilities and intellectual property to catalyse further research and development (R&D).

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The benefits from RIE investments extend beyond the economy to society at large.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: For example, our National Precision Medicine Programme aims to develop more targeted treatments based on the genetic make-up of our patients and population.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Technologies such as floating solar photovoltaics and building-integrated photovoltaics allow us to optimise renewable energy generation from our limited land size.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also deepen international research partnerships which reinforce Singapore’s position as a trusted node of technology, innovation and enterprise.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: These partnerships extend beyond extensive research collaborations at the individual and institutional levels, to joint dialogue platforms like the Singapore-France Joint Committee on Science and Innovation, and collaborations with multiple overseas universities under the Campus for Research Excellence and Technological Enterprise (CREATE) initiative.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: These investments focus on areas of high impact and strategic importance, including advanced manufacturing and engineering, health and biomedical sciences, sustainability and urban solutions, as well as artificial intelligence (AI), quantum and digital technologies.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: These will target selected economic sectors and national strategic priorities respectively.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will take a systematic approach to define desired economic and strategic outcomes, identify major bottlenecks where R&D is needed and develop a coordinated portfolio of research programmes to realise our goals.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: These programmes will draw on relevant research and translational capabilities across Singapore, including through partnerships with private sector players.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will strengthen our portfolio of research grants, fellowships and investigatorships to nurture local researchers, attract top-tier and promising research talent and enhance links between our researchers and the global community.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also establish a long-term plan to maintain and upgrade our essential research infrastructure.
